newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins ease in calm trade, eye holidays.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins ease in calm trade, eye holidays.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased as the market paused for breath after an active few days leading up to the Constitution Day holidays.
December 12 and 13 are market holidays in Russia, while Saturday and Sunday December 14 and 15 are working days.
"Prices have hardly fluctuated. The market seems to be getting ready for the holidays," National Reserve Bank dealer Andrei Ivanov-Golitsyn said.
Dealers said volume traded was notably lower than on Monday and Tuesday, when bank clients were investing mainly in the fifth tranche.
As a result, the 2008 maturity firmed a big figure on Monday and Tuesday. It currently has support and resistance levels at 42.75 and 42.80 respectively.
"The market has come into a pacified state. Profit-taking seems to be over and MinFins look firmer after U.S. Treasuries edged up," Sberbank dealer Pavel Sool said.

On Friday Treasury bond prices and many emerging debt markets were hit by Thurday's inflation warning from U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan, who said irrational exuberance in asset markets could damage the economy.
